answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 6 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 60 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. Without pigment the panel is blind, without jetty the farm is free, and without copper nobody can prove what happened.
